# CodeRa
> Chrome extension that extracts formatted code from video frames (YouTube, Udemy, Coursera) and screenshots using AI vision, preserving indentation. Free, no sign-up.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://codera.click/)
- [How to copy code from a YouTube video](https://codera.click/how-to-copy-code-from-youtube.html)
- [How to copy code from Udemy videos](https://codera.click/how-to-copy-code-from-udemy.html)
- [Extract code from a screenshot](https://codera.click/extract-code-from-screenshot.html)
- [Privacy](https://codera.click/privacy.html)
- [About](https://codera.click/about.html)
- [Changelog](https://codera.click/changelog.html)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/codera/achdkjdakdpnihgjhdgmodgamefkffid)

## Product facts
- Modes: plain text, extract as code, understand code
- Capture: Alt+C, floating button, select area, lesson collection while watching
- Local snippet library with filters and GitLab Snippets publish
- Exports: Obsidian, Notion Markdown, Anki
- Author: Anton Zakharenka
